Tooltip_TienCoolerIceBag: Keeps food fresh inside a cooler. Melts slowly in a cooler, quickly anywhere else, and refreezes in a powered fridge or freezer.
Tooltip_TienCoolers_Freeze: Leave it in the powered freezer for %1 hours. Every %2 units of water becomes one bag of ice, adding up across everything you set to freeze in there.
